tei:div.tei:p: ༄༅/ /yang zlog gi ngag 'don rgyun gyi nyams len bkol zhing bsgrigs pa bzhugs so//

sangs rgyas kyi bstan pa rgyas par bya ba dang sems can thams cad byang chub thob pa'i slad du bdag dang bsrung bya'i bar chad gnas skabs dang mthar thug gi zhi bar bya ba'i phyir 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed kyi bsrung ba'i 'khor lo chen po bsgom par bya'o// oṃ ye shes lnga/ swa bhā wa rang bzhin/ shud+dhaḥ dag pa/ sarba thams cad/ dharmā chos/ swa bhā wa rang bzhin dag pa/ shud+dho3haṃ ngo bo/ 'jam dpal thugs kyi rgyud rtsa ba chen po'i le'u nyer gsum par/ de bzhin nyid dang kun tu snang*// rgyu dang ting 'dzin rnam gsum bsgom// zhes pa'i don ni/ chos thams cad rang bzhin gyis ngo bo stong chos dbyings stong pa nyid las byang chub pa zhing chos dang gang zag gi bdag med par gyur/ brtan g.yo'i chos thams cad 'od gsal stong pa nyid du skad cig la 'jug pa ste/ 'di ni 'chi ba'i gnas skabs sbyong byed chos sku ste 'chi ba lam du slong ba chos sku'i lam 'khyer kyi skabs so// de'ang gshin rje dgra nag po'i 'khor lo las thams cad 'grub par byed pa zhes bya ba'i rgyud paṇ+ḍi ta mkhas pa thugs rje chen po dang*/ lo tsā ba rwa rdo rje grags kyi 'gyur/ phyis paṇ+ḍi ta sa man+ta shrī dang lo tsā ba rwa chos rab kyis 'gyur bcos mdzad pa las/ brtan dang g.yo ba'i dngos po rnams// yod min med min gnyis ka yin// gnyis ka med pa'ang ma yin te/ /spros bral ngo bo med par bsgom// zhes gsungs pas stong zhing bdag med pa mtha' bzhi dang bral ba bsam pa yin no// dharma dhā tu āḥ zhes pas kun la khyab pa'i snying rje dgra nag gi rgyud de nyid las/ dkyil 'khor sgom pa'i tshe na yang*// byams dang snying rje dga' btang snyoms// tshad med pa yi rim pa yis// sems can rnams la phan btags te// zhes gsungs pa'ang gong gi dgra nag gi rgyud kyi le'u dang don mthun pa'o// zhes gsungs pa'i don yin no// 'phags pa 'jam dpal dri med gsang ba'i rgyud kyi le'u nyer gsum par yang*/

snying rje'i sems dang ma bral zhing*/ */byams pa la sogs ma bral na// rang sems rnam par dag gyur ste// yid bzhin nor bu lta bur 'gyur// chen po kun snang gi ting nge 'dzin bsgom de 'dzin/ bo dhi tsit+ta byang chub sems/ hūm̐| rang sems chos spros bral blo 'das nyid kyi ngang las rang gi rig pa'i ngo bo rgyu'i yi ge hūm̐ 'di rgyu'i ting nge 'dzin mthing nag /de hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros pas raṃ me/ yaṃ rlung*/ khaṃ chu zhes bdag dang bdag gi ba'i dngos 'dzin thams cad 'od gsal stong pa nyid don dam pa'i me rlung chus bsregs gtor sbyangs bkrus par byas/ rgyu'i yi ge snga ma de rang hūm̐ mngon brjod sna tshogs gsal ba hūm̐ gi rnam par gnon pa dang sbyin pa'i don la bshad pas/ skabs 'dir rnams su ni| zhing bcu tshang ba'i log 'dren rnam par gnon pa dang*/ sems can la dngos grub rnam pa gnyis sbyin pa'i don zhes 'bru mnan du rung ba yin no/ yi ge e chad pas nam mkha' mthing ga gru gsum pa gyur/ yaṃ 'phros pa las rlung rdo rje rgya gram ljang gu gyi lte bar/ raṃ las spros pa me'i dkyil 'khor zur gsum dmar po/ baṃ las chu'i dkyil 'khor zlum po dkar po/ laṃ las spros pa gser gyi sa gzhi gru bzhi pa ser po'i steng du bh+rūṃ las spros pa mchod rten dkar po 'od zer kha dog lnga ldan 'phro ba/ de'i mchod rten phyi'i rgyu a sogs thabs ā di| ka sogs shes rab kā di las grub pa ngo bo rdo rje pha lam/ rnam pa byang chub chen po'i mchod rten gyi dbyibs can de'ang*/ gdan khri bang rim gsum pa/ de'i steng du ri rab ri rab de'i steng du bang rim bzhi pa/ bum pa de'i steng du bre dang chos 'khor rim pa bcu gsum gyi steng du gdugs dang tog gi steng du nyi ma dang zla ba dang nor bu dang bcas pa/

'od dang 'od zer dpe cha rnying pa la lar sna tshogs zer ba bcug 'dug go// phyogs bcur 'phros pas stong gsum khengs par gyur/ mchod rten de'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba'i nang du hūm̐ rgyu hūm̐ de la mar me las 'od 'phros pa ltar rgya gram gsal gdab bo// las gser gyi rdo rje rgya gram rwa sprag gi gyi dra mig rnams su rdo rje'i tsha tsha chi li li khol ba/ nang ga'u kha sbyor gyi rnam par yod pa'i nang du pad zla nyi ma'i steng du shel gyi rdo rje rtse lnga pa 'od zer kun tu 'phro ba'i lte bar hūm̐ mthing nag sngar gyi rgyu'i yi ge de las 'od zer 'phros pas/ ya ma gshin rje/ ti ra baṃ bam ro/ zhes pas gshin rje pho dang mo bsnol ba'i gdan/ de'i steng du ma he dang glang rgod pho mo gnyis gnyis bsnol ba'i gdan la gdan nyi zla las byang chub pa nyi zla dang de'i 'og tu pad+ma gsum brtsegs kyi steng du/ sngar gyi rgyu'i yi ge hūm̐ mthing nag gsung yi ge las byang chub pa de las 'od zer lnga dang ldan pa chad de gnas pa las 'od zer 'phro bzhin par hūm̐ de nyid gdan gsum brtsegs de'i steng du spro bsdu med par hūm̐ 'od du zhu ba las rdo rjer bsgoms pa zhal gdams la lar 'dug /'phros dgra bgegs thams cad tshar bcad tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ gnam lcags kyi thugs phyag mtshan las byang chub pa rdo rje rtse dgu pa hūm̐ yig mthing gas mtshan par bar dor pha ma'i khu khrag dang dri za nying mtshams sbyor ba sbyang phyir dbyangs ū dang gsal byed ha yig nga ro nā da rnams tshogs pa las mngal gyi gnas skabs bcu dang*/ phung po lnga dug lnga sogs sbyang phyir mgo bo mnyam nyid/ zla tshes me long lta bu/ thig le nā da chos dbyings/ zhabs kyu bya grub/

khog pa sor rtog ste ye shes lnga ldan ye nas yin pa la yin pa'i dran shes bskyed pa/ rnam pa hūm̐ la ngo bor longs sku nges pa lnga ldan nyid yin pa ni bar do'i gnas skabs sbyong byed bar do lam du slong ba longs sku'i lam 'khyer gyi skabs so// gyur/ de las 'od zer phyogs thams cad du 'phros pas 'phags pa rnams mchod mtshams 'dir 'jig rten gyi dregs byed thams cad tshar bcad zer ba zhal gdams su 'dug go// sems can thams cad gyi don byas/ tshur 'dus yongs su gyur pa las oṃ rdo rje hūm̐ dang bcas rgyu rdo rje 'dzin pa'i rang bzhin can yongs su gyur pa las 'bras bu rdo rje 'dzin pa bzhengs pa'i phyir bskyed pa can gyi sngags brjod pa skad cig gis lha bskyed pa yin la/ a kro bcu gcig pa 'di lha bskyed pa'i sngags yin par gshin rje dmar nag 'bar ba'i dme rgyud du gsungs 'dug go// las kyi kha brgyud de skye ba len pa sbyang phyir sgyu ma lta bu'i lha bsgoms te skye ba'i gnas skabs sbyong byed gdul bya rigs can rigs min thams cad 'dul phyir mchog gi sprul sku ste skye ba lam du slong ba sprul sku'i lam 'khyer gyi skabs so// sku gsum lam 'khyer 'di bskyed rim gyi lam 'gag zab cing rdo rje theg pa'i brjod bya rgya che shos gcig yin pas go don dang lung rigs mtha' yas kyang 'dir ma bris so// a sku yongs su rdzogs pa las byang chub pa ste mngon byang lnga bskyed do// kro te ka ya mān+ta ka hūm̐ phaṭ/ rang nyid slar gsal gdab pa ni 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed/ sku mdog mthing nag dbu gsum phyag drug zhabs zhal gsum dor stabs zer ba 'dug /bzhi bgrad pa/ g.yas sprul sku'i zhal dkar la bzhad pa 'dzum zhing dgyes pa'i nyams can/ g.yon longs sku'i zhal dmar la gshe ba brtse chags 'dres pa'i nyams can/

dbus chos sku'i zhal mthing la rngam sgra dgu dang ldan pa/ zhal re re la dmar la zlum 'khrugs pa zhes zhal gdams su 'byung*/ pa'i spyan gsum g.yo 'khrul 'khrugs pa dang ldan pa/ snyan gong g.yas g.yon gnyis sbrul nag re res brgyan pa/ khro gnyer gsum gsum smin ma'i mtshams su bsdus pa/ shangs gyen du gnyer ba/ zhal gdangs ljags ya rkan la 'dril mche ba bzhi bzhi gtsigs pa/ zhal nas ā ra li'i sgra sgrogs ā ra li'i tshab tu hūm̐ phaṭa kyi sgra sgrog pa/ zhes zhal gdams la lar 'dug go// smin ma dang sma ra ag tshom nyams dmar ser glog ltar 'khyug pa/ dbu skra kham ser gyen du brdzes zhal gsum 'khyil ba zhes 'byung*/ pa 'bar zhing*/ phyag g.yas dang pos mtshon cha'i 'khor lo gnam lcags rtsibs brgyad rno ba'i ngar can/ bar pas ral gri rdo rje'i yu ba can 'debs pa'i rtags/ tha mas rdo rje rtse dgu pa gsor zhing 'phen pa'i stangs kyis bsnams pa/ phyag g.yon dang pos lcags kyu 'phyar stabs/ bar pas gtun shing bkan nas 'dzin pa/ 'og ma na sdigs mdzub kyi rtse la me 'bar ba zhes zhal gdams su 'byung*/ mdzad pa la me 'bar ba/ zhabs bzhi g.yas nang du cung zad bskum zhing g.yon brkyang ba'i gar gyis bzhengs pa/ thod skam lnga lngas dbu la brgyan pa'i nang du khrag 'thung zhal so so'i thod skam dbus ma'i nang du bud+dha khrag 'thung de'i g.yas dang por badz+ra khrag 'thung gnyis par pad+ma g.yon dang por rat+na gnyis par karma rigs lngas mtshan pa/ de'i spyi gtsug tu ye shes kyi bya khyung nag po khro zhal can rdo rje'i mchu dang*/ nyi zla'i spyan can/ gnam lcags kyi rwa rwa bar nor bus spras pa zhes zhal gdams las so// dbu skra kham nag 'khyil nas rwa sprag tu nor bus mtshan pa/

rkang lag lcags kyi sder mos 'di'i mjug tu zhal gdams su mjug ma rkang pas mnan pa zhes pa 'dug go| |sbrul dkar nag gnyis bzung nas mgo bo zhal du gsol ba/ sgro gshog spu gri zhal gdams su 'khor lo dang ral gri'i gshog pa can zhes 'byung ngo*// la bskal pa'i me 'bar bas brdegs pa klu dang sa bdag thams cad dmyal thag gcod pa/ spu phran mtshon cha can cig lding ba'o/ gtso bo'i ba spu'i bu ga thams cad du'ang khyung nag me'i gshog pa can dang rdo rje rtse lnga pas gtams pa las me stag 'phro ba/ thod pa ra ri skam ma nim nyi shu rtsa gcig gis mgul rgyan byas pa/ thod rlon khrag 'dzag pa lnga bcu rtsa gcig gis se ral khar brgyan pa/ sku stod la glang chen gyi ko rlon mgo bo g.yas su phyogs pa gsol ba/ sku sked zhal gdams su glang zhing gnyis ka sku stod du byas 'dug go// la zhing lpags kyi g.yang gzhi mgo g.yas su bstan nas lag pa dang rkang pa g.yas su mdud nas bcings pa/ sku smad la stag lpags kyi sham thabs dkris pa mgo bo g.yas su grol ba/ sbrul rigs lnga las rgyal rigs dkar khras dbu skra bcings shing*/ bram ze ser khras phyag gdub byas pa/ dmangs rigs dmar khras ske rags byas pa/ rje'u rigs ljang gus zhabs gdub byas pa/ gdol pa nag khras se ral khar brgyan pa phrag gong g.yon du mdud pa/ thal chen gyi tshom bus bhan+da'i dbyibs smin mtshams dang sku'i nywa sul rnams su byugs pa/ rak+ta'i thig les kha ṭ+wāṃ gi dbyibs mkhur tshos dang dpral bar brgyan pa/ zhag gi zo ris rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i dbyibs kyis lkog ma brang bshal ba/ sku las sprul pa'i pho nya grangs med pa 'phro ba/ gtso bo de'i 'khor las kyi gshin rje bsam gyis mi khyab pas bskor ba/

gtso bo'i rang lus las 'phros pa'i me ri dang me dpung rdo rje me'i tsha tsha 'phro ba'i nang du bzhugs pa/ de'i thugs kar gser gyi zhal gdams su thugs kar 'khor lo med par thugs kar 'jam dpal ser nag srung zlog byed skabs sbyar de'i thugs kar rdo rje rtse lnga pa sogs dkyus ltar sgom pa'ang 'dug go// 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi pa/ rtsibs rnams la 'jam dpal gser btso ma'i mdog can zhal gcig /phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas shes rab kyi ral gri dpung pa'i thad sor 'dzin cing*/ g.yon pa'i mtheb srin gyis ut+pala'i yu ba thugs kar 'dzin cing*/ 'dab ma snyan gyi thad dkar kha bye ba rgyas pa'i steng du shes rab kyi pha rol tu phyin pa'i po ti bsnams pa/ zhabs rdo rje'i skyil krung du bzhugs shing*| dar gyi stod g.yogs dang smad g.yogs dang rin po ches brgyan pa/ zhi zhing 'dzum pa'i mdangs dang ldan zhing*/ ral pa'i zur phud lnga dang ldan pa/ zhal nang du gzigs nas bsrung ba'i las mdzad par gyur/ 'khor lo'i lte bar pad+ma zla nyi'i steng du/ rin po che sna tshogs las grub pa'i mchod rten 'od zer sna tshogs 'phro ba/ de'i bum pa'i nang du pad zla nyi ma'i gdan la hūm̐ mthing nag las gser gyi bdag dam tshig sems dpa'i thugs kar sangs rgyas thams cad kyi thugs rdo rje sems dpa'i ngo bor bsgoms pa rdo rje rtse lnga pa/ yar gyi rwa lnga la rigs lnga yab lnga/ dbus rwa rnam snang dkar po zhal rang nyid kyi mdun ngos su blta ba/ mdun rwa la mi bskyod pa sngon po/ rang gi gzhogs g.yas ngos kyi rwa la rin 'byung ser po/ rgyab rwa la snang mtha' dmar po/ rang gi gzhogs g.yon rwa la don grub ljang gu ste phyogs kyi yum bzhi zhal nang du blta ba/ mar gyi rwa lnga la rigs lnga yum dbus rwa la rdo rje dbyings phyug ma dkar mo rang gi mdun ngos la zhal blta ba/ mdun rwa la mā ma kī sngon po/

rang gi gzhogs g.yas rwa la spyan ma ser mo/ rgyab rwa la gos dkar dmar mo/ rang gi gzhogs g.yon rwa la sgrol ma ljang gu ste phyogs kyi yum bzhi zhal nang du blta ba'o// lngas mtshan pa'i lte bar rgyu ā di kā di las grub pa'i nyi zla'i ga'u kha sbyor gyi nang du tshe'i sa bon bh+rūṃ yig gi lte bar hūm̐ ye shes sems dpa'i thugs kar sa bon ting 'dzin sems dpa'i ngo bor bsgoms pa sems dpa' gsum dang ldan pa mthing nag 'od zer 'bar ba zhig bsam/ de'i mthar e ka ya ma du ru tsakras g.yas skor du bskor ba/ sa bon dang sngags 'bru thams cad nyal stabs ma yin par gdan la khab btsugs pa ltar 'greng thabs su bsgom/ hūm̐ gi klad kor nang du bla ma dang slob dpon/ khog par rang gzhan bsrung bya'i ming yig dang pos nṛ la bskor ba/ de'i mthar srung sngags de'i mthar ā di dkar po g.yas skor du bsam pa zhal gdams su 'dug /zhabs kyu'i nang du 'khor dang nor rdzas thams cad gsal bar 'dir yab dang yum khyung gsum dngos su bsgom zhing khyams khang gi rang bzhin mchod rten dang dregs pa'i phyag mtshan rdo rje ya ma rā dza'i sa bon hūm̐ rnams bsgoms pas rtsa ba'i lha drug po don gyis tshang ba yin pa'ang shes pa byos shig /gyur/ rang tshe bdag tu gsal ba'i thugs ka nas 'od zer dmar nag cig 'phros pa'i rtse la bh+yo smug nag 'od dang bcas pa g.yon du chad pa 'phro 'dus yongs su gyur pa las/ yum ma mo khrag mig ma zhal gdams la lar 'byung ba'i yum zhes pa'ang 'byung*/ smug nag zhal gdams la lar dmar nag zer ba dang*/ zhal gdams kha cig tu mthing ga byas pa'ang 'dug /zhal gcig /phyag gnyis/ gcer bu rgyan med pa/ shin tu 'jigs pa/ phyag g.yas lcags kyu zhal gdams la lar gri gug byas pa'ang 'dug /nam mkhar 'phyar ba/ g.yon pas thod khrag thugs kar bsnams pa/

zhabs gnyis dor stabs su bzhugs pa gzig gi sham thabs mgo g.yas su grol ba can/ 'khor ma mo bye ba sa yas bskor ba dang bcas pa/ rang lus las 'phros pa'i me ri'i nang du bzhugs pa'i thugs kar bh+yo smug nag gi mthar/ he ka ya ma du ru tsakras bskor bar gyur/ yang yab kyi thugs ka nas 'od zer dmar nag cig 'phros pa'i rtse las ya dmar nag 'phros pa las yab kyi g.yas su sras mchog ya ma gshin rje/ rā tsa rgyal po/ sku mdog dmar nag zhal gcig /phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas bshan gri rtse mo dbal can la sum 'khyog gi rnam par yod pa/ dmar po nam mkhar 'phyar ba/ g.yon tsit+ta dmar tsa ra ra 'drad pa/ mi lpags kyi g.yang gzhi dmar tsa re mgo g.yas su bstan pa ba sku la gsol ba/ zhabs gnyis sa la brdebs pa/ mgo g.yas su 'khyog pa stag lpags kyi sham thabs can/ 'khor sde brgyad yongs kyis bskor ba dang bcas pa/ rang lus las spros pa'i me dpung gi nang na bzhugs pa'i thugs kar ya dmar nag gi mthar/ gh+ri ma ya ma du ru tsakras g.yas skor du bskor bar gyur/ slar yang rang gi thugs ka'i hūm̐ dang bh+yo las bsrung ba'i khro bo khro mo g.yas g.yon du zhal du nang gyu zlog pa'i dus su lha tshogs thams cad kyang zhal phyir gyu nas bzlog pa'i las mdzad par gyur/ nas bsrung ba'i gur khang du gyur/ de ltar bskyed pa'i steng du bla ma slob dpon g.yas su pho rgyud khro bo'i rang bzhin g.yon du mo rgyud khro mo'i rang bzhin rdzas dang mdzod rgyab tu phyugs ma mdun du bsam mo zhes zhal gdams la lar 'dug go/ */gur khang mchod rten gyi phyi rol du bh+rūṃ las gser gyi ga'u kha sbyor gyi gur khang*/ de'i phyi rol du hūm̐ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa ces pas khro bo sngon po rdo rje rtse dgu lnga gsum gcig pa sogs sna tshogs pa/ sngon po thogs pa dang rdo rje sngon po'i mi bskyod pa'i rang bzhin gur khang*/

rlung bser bu tsam yang mi thar bar gyur/ de'i phyi rol du oṃ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa/ ces pas khro bo dkar po mtshon cha'i 'khor lo dkar po thogs pa dang 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad stong sogs sna tshogs pa dkar po'i gur khang rnam snang gi rang bzhin rlung bser bu tsam yang mi thar bar gyur/ de'i phyi rol du trāṃ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa ces pas khro bo ser po nor bu ser po cha dgu pa sogs thogs pa dang nor bu ser po'i gur khang rin 'byung gi rang bzhin rlung bser bu tsam yang mi thar bar gyur/ de'i phyi rol du hrīḥs+pha ra ṇa phaṭa ces pas khro bo dmar po phyag na pad+ma 'dab ma mang nyung sna tshogs pa dmar po thogs pa dang pad+ma dmar po'i gur khang 'od dpag med kyi rang bzhin rlung bser bu tsam yang mi thar bar gyur/ de'i phyi rol du āḥs+pha ra ṇa phaṭa ces pas khro bo ljang gu sna tshogs rdo rje rtse mo mang nyung sna tshogs pa thogs pa dang sna tshogs rdo rje'i gur khang don grub kyi rang bzhin rlung bser bu tsam yang mi thar bar gyur 'di'i tshab tu de rgyab tri las ral gri dang mtshon cha sna tshogs kyi gur khang zhes pa zhal gdams la lar 'dug go// de'i phyi rol du tīk+ṣ+ṇa maṇ+ḍal zhes pas gnam lcags kyi ral gri ngar ma'i 'khor lo g.yon du drag tu 'khor bas gnod byed gang yin mya la la gtub pa'i gur khang*/ de'i phyi rol du yaṃ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa ces pas rlung nag 'tshubs ma'i gur khang dam tshig sgrol ma'i rang bzhin nang du khro bo kham nag rlung g.yab sngo ljang dang mtshon cha sna tshogs bsnams pas gang zhing gtams pa/ de'i phyi rol du raṃ s+pha ra ṇa phaṭa raṃ dz+wa la maṇ+ḍal zhes pas me dpung 'bar ba'i gur khang gos dkar mo'i rang bzhin nang du khro bo dmar nag me dpung 'bar ba thogs pas gang zhing gtams pa/ de'i phyi rol du baṃ tīk+ṣ+ṇa maṇ+ḍal zhes pas chu bo rba klong 'khyil ba'i gur khang mā ma kī'i rang bzhin nang du khro bo dkar po chu 'i zhags pa thogs pas gang zhing gtams pa/

de'i phyi rol du laṃ tīk+ṣ+ṇa maṇ+ḍal zhes pas gser gyi rdo rje rgya gram gyi gur khang sangs rgyas spyan ma'i rang bzhin nang du khro bo ser po ri rab bang rim bzhi pa thogs pas gang zhing gtams pa/ de'i phyi rol du e maṇ+ḍal zhes pas nam mkha' lcags kyi gur khang dbyings phyug ma'i rang bzhin mthing nag gi spyil po'i tshul du bzhugs pa la srung sngags dang ā di kā di'i rang sgra sgrog pa'i gur khang zhes zhal gdams la lar 'dug /nang du khro bo nag po mtshon cha sna tshogs char ltar dbab pas gang zhing gtams pa'i gur khang*/ de thams cad kyang sra zhing mkhregs pa'i rwa bar khro chung mtshon cha sna tshogs thogs pa dang*/ nam mkha' rdo rje phra mo'i tshogs mang po dang*/ rlung spu gri reg gcod dang*/ ye shes kyi me dpung 'bar ba dang*/ chu gri dang mtshon cha rnam pa sna tshogs kyi 'khor lo mang po 'tshubs pa dang gtams pa las shin tu drag po'i 'od zer dang bcas pa 'phros kha dog sna tshogs pa rno zhing tsha la rtsub pa phyogs bcur pas dgra bgegs thams cad mtha'i rgya mtsho'i pha rol tu bskrad cing*/ ma song ba thams cad kyang thal ba'i rdul phran bzhin du brlag par gyur par bsam mo// de'i phyi rol du rang sngags srung zlog bsad mnan gang yin dang ā di kā di'i ā di dkar po g.yas skor dang kā di dmar po g.yon skor du bsgom dgos pa zhal gdams nas 'byung*/ phreng ba 'khrigs pa dang dgra bo thams cad sod ces pa'i stong nyid kyi rang nā da'i sgra sgrog pa'i gur khang rnams su gsal bar gyur/ lha tshogs thams cad kyi spyi bor 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pa dkar po lte bar oṃ dkar po/ gyis mtshan pa/ mgrin pa pad+ma dmar po 'dab ma brgyad pa'i lte bar āḥs dmar po/ mtshan pa/ snying gar rdo rje rtse lnga pa'i lte bar sngon po hūm̐ mthing ga

/gis mtshan pa thugs ka'i hūm̐ las 'od zer 'phros/ rang bzhin gyis gnas nas zhes pa ni chos thams cad 'byung khungs spros bral 'od gsal 'dus ma byas pa'i dbyings yin no// 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed yab yum sras gsum bsrung ba'i gur khang dang bcas pa badz+ra rdo rje bsdu bas byon/ sa mā dzaḥ yang zlog gi phrin las gzhung la don bdun yod pa'i dang po spyan drang ba ni/ hūm̐ */ dad pa dang ni dam tshig la gnas pa bdag gis/ /'jam dpal gshin rje yab yum 'khor bcas spyan 'dren no/ /'og min dag pa'i zhing mchog chos kyi dbyings mkha' khyab spros bral 'dus ma byas pa gshis sam babs kyi pho brang nas// gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i gzhal yas nas// 'phags pa'i rgyal po rdzogs pa'i sangs rgyas khro rgyal gshin rje'i gshed| |bdag dang mtha' yas sems can thams cad phrin las rnam bzhis 'dul ba'i don slad du// thugs rjes dgongs la gnas 'dir gshegs su gsol// yum mchog ma mo khrag mig gshegs su gsol// sras mchog ya ma rā tsa 'khor bcas gshegs su gsol/ oṃ mañju 'jam/ shrī dpal/ ya mān+ta ka gshin rje'i/ ya ma gshed/ rā dza rgyal po/ ma mo e ka gcig /dzā ti ral pa/ sa ma ya dam tshig dzaḥdzaḥ byon/ gnyis pa bzhugs su gsol ba ni/ hūm̐ */ drag po chos kyi dbyings gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i gzhal yas na// gshin rje ma he nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan steng du// khro rgyal gshin rje yab yum sras 'khor bcas pa rnams/ zhabs brkyang bskum sku 'gying bag gsung rngam thugs brjid pa'i tshul gyis bzhugs su gsol/ dam tshig sa ma ya brtan pa tiṣ+ṭha lhan bzhugs/ gsum pa phyag 'tshal ba ni/ hūm̐ */ dgra phyi gdon pho mo klu gsum nang du las dang bag chags mtshan 'dzin gsum/

bgegs phyi sdang dgra nang nyon mongs ma lus thal ba rlog byed pa'i// khro rgyal ji skad du/ gshin rje'i gshed po mthong ba na// khro bo gzhan rnams lag cha 'chor// gshin rje'i gshed la phyag 'tshal lo// ma mo chen mo khrag mig ma la phyag 'tshal lo// sras mchog ya ma rā tsa 'khor bcas phyag 'tshal lo// a ti pū phyag bgyid do// hoḥ pra so sor bzhes shig tīts+tsha hoḥ bzhi pa mchod pa 'bul ba ni/ hūm̐ */ 'phags pa'i rgyal po khro rgyal gshin rje'i gshed// yab yum sras 'khor sprul pa yang sprul tshogs bcas la// dngos 'byor yid kyis sprul pa'i mchod tshogs 'bul// me phyi mchod tog bdug spos mar me dri chab zhal zas dang*// sil snyan la sogs mchod pa 'bul lo bzhes su gsol// nang mchod bdud rtsi sman gyi mchod pa 'bul lo bzhes su gsol// dam rdzas gtor ma'i mchod pa 'bul lo bzhes su gsol// rak+ta 'dod chags dug lnga'i mchod pa 'bul lo bzhes su gsol// gsang mchod sbyor rgyud las zhing bcu bsgral ba rlung yin te sogs gsungs pa'i phyir de kho na nyid kyi mchod pa yin sgrol rnams kyi mchod pa 'bul lo bzhes su gsol/ ar+ghaṃ mchod yon/ pā d+yaṃ zhabs bsil/ puṣ+paṃ me tog /dhū paṃ bdug pa/ ā lo kaṃ snang gsal/ gan+dhaṃ/ dri chab/ nai wi d+ye zhal zas/ shapad rol mo/ āḥhūm̐ skye ba med par sbyin/ swā hā gzhi tshugs/ raṃ me/ yaṃ rlung*/ khaṃ chu/ gis gnyis 'dzin gyi dngos po bsregs gtor bkrus/ oṃ āḥhūm̐/ gsum brjod/ dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag bdud rtsir gyur/ oṃ sarba thams cad/ pañca lnga/ a mṛta 'chi med/ kha raṃ bzhes/ khā hi rol/ ma hā chen po/ ba ling+ta= gtor ma/ ma hā rak+ta= dmar/ maṃ sa= sha/

keṃ ni ri ti= rus pa/ go ro tsa na= klad pa/ tsit+ta= snying*/ ba su ta rgyu ma/ kha raṃ khā hi/ bo dhi byang chub/ tsit+ta sems/ ma traṃ log 'dren/ ru tra ma rungs pa/ pra we sha ya dbab pa/ phaṭa khol/ lnga pa bstod pa ni/ e/ chos sku skye ba med pa las| chos sku/ spros pa dang bral ba bde ba chen po yang dag pa'i sku// rang bzhin dag pa mtha' gnyis su med pa'i gsung*// 'khor 'das thams cad ma sgrib par don rnams rdzogs par mkhyen pa'i thugs// 'gran pa'i zla kun dang bral ba'i yon tan thams cad dang ldan// 'gro ba kun gyi don mdzad pa'i phrin las bzhi sogs sprul sku// sku gsung thugs dang yon tan phrin las kyis| |sems can thams cad kyi don mdzad pa khro rgyal gshin rje'i gshed// yab yum sras 'khor bcas la phyag 'tshal bstod// drug pa bshags pa bya ba ni/ bdag gis tshe rabs thog ma med pa'i tshun chad nas// da lta'i lus 'di blangs pa yan chad du// lus kyis sdig byas spyod srog gcod 'dod g.yem rku 'phrog sogs/ pa ngan du spyad// ngag rdzun dang phra ma dbyen tshig rtsub sogs/ gis tshig 'chal smra ba mang du brjod// yid brnab sems gnod sems log lta the tshom sogs/ kyis blo nor log par sems la sogs// mdor na 'dod chags dang zhe sdang gis khro ba dang gti mug gi dbang gis las ngan ci spyad pa// bkram pa'i ye gdod ma nas grub cing da lta gsal btab spyan drangs pa'i don/ lha tshogs rnams la bzod par gsol// ye shes lha la khro ba sogs kyi rtog pa mi mnga' yang*// de'i 'khor du gtogs pa'i lha srin dregs pa rnams// mi ngag 'don rnying pa la lar mi g.yel zer ba dang la lar mi g.yo zhes 'byung ngo*// yi skyon de rnams mthong tsam nas brlag par mdzad// de bas na nor 'khrul chag nyams mchis gang mchis pa thams cad na bzod par gsol gyi/

bzod par gsol la rnal 'byor bdag la tshangs pa'i dngos grub rnam pa gnyis stsol// 'di dang phyi ma gnyis kyi rkyen dang sgrib par mi 'gyur bar mdzad du gsol/ ā di kā di dang*/ oṃ ya ma rā dza sa ma ya/ ma nu pā la ya/ ya ma rā dza twe no pa/ sogs yig brgya brjod/ dzaḥhūm̐ baṃ hoḥ zhes spyan drangs pa'i gur khang dang lha ye shes sems dpa'i tshogs rnams 'od kyi tshul du bsgoms pa'i gur khang dang dam tshig sems dpa' la thim pas dam tshig pa dang ye shes pa dbyer med du gyur par bsam zhes gzhung nas 'byung ngo*// sde brgyad bran du 'khol zhing snying rjes gdug pa can thams cad dus gcig la brlag nus pa/ gzhan gyi byad stems rig sngags kyis mi tshugs pa'i mthu zhal gdams la lar mthu rtsal kyi dbang dang ldan par gyur ces pa'ang 'dug /rtsal dang ldan par gyur cig /zla gsang 'dus pa'i tan+t+ra'i le'u drug cu pa las kyi phyi rgyud bstan pa'i skabs su/ las kyi bye brag gang byed kyang*// ya mān+ta ka dang mi 'bral// lha yi sku mdog phyag mtshan ni// rgyas bsdus gang byed dmigs dang sbyar// zhes gsungs 'dug pas las rab 'byams gang sgrub kyang lha'i bskyed rim dang ma bral bar byas/ de yang phyag drug pa'am/ phyag gnyis pa skabs dang sbyor/ skabs 'dir bskyed rim la gsal snang thon nges kyi bar ci gnas su bsgom/ des skyo na 'dzab bzla ba yin no// bdun pa 'dzab bzla ba rnams so// lha tshogs thams cad kyi thugs ka nas hūm̐ las 'od zer sna tshogs pa dang las byed pho nya sprul pa yang sprul gsum sprul khro bo khro mo'i tshogs dpag tu med par 'phros pas/ rang gzhan bsrung bya thams cad kyi tshe srog gi ngo bo yi ge nṛ'i rnam par lha srin sde brgyad thams cad kyis brkus 'phrog nas mtho nam mkha'| dma' dmyal ba/ nyi zla'i them bar/ sprin gyi go bar/ ri rab kyi lcog bar/

'dzam gling gi yul gru/ sa bla/ sa 'og /sa steng gar khyer zhing bskungs nas yod pa de nyid sprul pa'i khro bo khro mo rnams kyis ye shes kyi spyan gyis gzigs nas gnod byed thal ba'i rdul du brlag /tshe srog gi ngo bo de 'phrog nas nṛ hūm̐ gi rnam par byas nas rang gzhan bsrung bya thams cad kyi thugs khar bstims pas bkrag dang gzi mdangs rgyas shing phun sum tshogs par gyur/ yang rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros pas/ bla ma yi dam sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' sems ma dpa' bo mkha' 'gro chos skyong pho rgyud mo rgyud rnams kyi byin rlabs/ lha ma srin sde brgyad kyi srog snying*/ lha mi rnams kyi tshe dang bsod nams/ 'byung ba lnga'i bcud thams cad rang dbang med par bkug nas rang gzhan bsrung bya thams cad la bstims pas bkrag mdangs mthu stobs dang ldan par gyur/ chos sku oṃ e ka ya ma du ru tsakras srungs/ longs sku he ka ya ma du ru tsakras srungs/ sprul sku gh+ri ma ya ma du ru tsakras srungs/ sarba tsit+ta 'khor 'das thams cad kyi snying po/ gzir thuṃ/ bhig nan 'gugs pa/ trig nan gzir ba/ rbad ya rbad pa/ zlog ya zlog pa/ saṃ gh+ri wa ri nṛ bh+rūṃ hūm̐ dzaḥbadag cag dpon slob mi nor 'khor dang bcas pa la rak+ṣa swā hā/ zhes pa'i sngags sngags 'grel 'di rnams rdo rje gtsug lag gi rgyud kyi le'u lnga bcu par 'dug go// rang lhar gsal ba'i phyi rim du sngags kyi 'od zer g.yas skor du yod par gyur/ lha tshogs thams cad kyi zhal nang du gyu nas srung sngags di ri ri bzla zhing bsrung ba'i gur khang rnams las kyang srung sngags 'brug stong dus gcig la ldir ba ltar sgrog pas srid pa gsum khyab cing bdag dang bsrung bya rnams la gzhan gyis byas pa'i rig sngags byad stems rbod gtong thams cad dang lha srin sde brgyad kyi 'tshe ba thams cad las srung zhing skyob par bsams nas bzla'o// zhes gzhung du bshad do// ces pa'i gong gi bsnyen pa la 'bad pa'i rtags kyi 'byung tshul gzhung du gsal/ rtags ni mkhar btsan por zhugs pa dang*/

go gyon pa/ mtshon cha bzung ba/ nyi ma shar ba/ ri rtser phyin pa dang rta rgyug pa/ dar phyar ba/ dung 'bud pa/ g.yul rgyal ba/ rtsod pa kun las rgyal ba/ chu la rdzings bcas mnyam par phyin pa sogs gcig tu ma nges sna tshogs yong bas rang re'i nyams dang bstun la brtag par bya'o// zhes pa lag len dngos gzhi'i gzhung du gsungs so// 'di yan chad yang zlog gi phrin las gzhung rnams so// gnyis pa zlog bsad rgyun gyi nyams len rno myur bya sla zhing nying zlog dang sbrel ba 'di bya ste/ smyug tshigs kyi bca' thabs zhal las dris| zlog bsad kyi dus thal rdeb kyi dmigs pa yang 'di yin no// rang gshin rjer gsal ba'i phyag g.yas zla phyag dang po gnyis kyi mthil du sgom dgos/ ba dang*/ g.yon nyi ma gsal ba'i bar du dgra bo byad ma mi nor 'khor dang bcas par gsal ba ni/ thal mo brdabs pas sha khrag dmar chal chal btang ba lha tshogs thams cad kyis hab di ri ri gsol bar bsam/ bsad pa'i dus kho rang gi lha srung gis kyang zos par bsam pa ni zlog bsad mnan pa'i sgrub pa'i skabs thal mo rdeb dus bsgom mo// gal che bar lan re gnyis tsam re byas de min rgyun du mi bya bar do gal dang bstun no// nṛ rak+sha sems chags nam mkha'i khams/ sha rak+sha sha chags 'di dang*/ khaṃ rak+sha khrag chags/ chu'i khams/ keṃ rak+sha rus chags/ 'di gnyis sa'i khams/ raṃ rak+sha drod chags/ me'i khams/ yaṃ rak+sha dbugs dang ldan/ rlung gi khams/ tshor ba de lnga dang ldan pa'i dgra bo pho mo sbyor ba byas pa'i sbyor mtshams nas rnam par shes pa yang yang bkug ste liṅga la bstim par gyur/ dgug gzhug byas te/ rang gi thugs ka'i sa bon las 'od zer 'phros pas khro bo khro mo lcags kyu dang*| byams pa/ zhags pa snying rje/ lcags sgrog dga' ba/ dril bu btang snyoms/ thogs pa dpag tu med par spros te/

nyi ma phyogs bzhi mtshams brgyad kyi dgra bgegs thams cad bkug par gyur| nṛ sha ku ru/ nṛ sha ku ru/ kha so pa ti yaṃ ru ti/ yaṃ sen yaṃ sen/ man yaṃ snying tshal pa rbad/ baṃ ril rbad/ dam nyams dgra bo byad ma khyod kyi bla rten/ tshe rten/ srog rten ci yod pa thams cad 'dir khug myur du shog cig /ces dang*/ yang*/ oṃ a kro te ka gshin rje/ ya mā'an+ta ka gshed/ kā la nag po/ rū pa gzugs/ dgra bo nṛ aṃ ku sha dzaḥdzaḥ khug cig /ya lha dbye/ ma gshin rje/ rā dza rgyal po/ rlung ling sang sang ma chags sang sang rnam par gnon/ ku ta hūm̐ phaṭa/ khos shig 'di yan bla 'gugs kyi sngags so// hūm̐ */ ka kā bya rog /mu kha gdong*/ mthu mo che/ mthing nag chen mo bya rog dbu// rtog med zas su sha za zhing*// khyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab// ul+lu mu kha 'ug pa'i gdong*/ mthu mo che// ser nag chen mo 'ug pa'i mgo// khyod gnyis nyin mtshan med par rgyug /khyod kyi thugs dam dus la bab// dgra dang dgra lha phrol la shog /lus dang srung ma phrol la shog /khyo dang chung ma phrol la shog /pha dang bu gnyis phrol la shog /phu bo nu bo phrol la shog /gnyen dang nye du phrol la shog /dgra lha spyi bo'i gtsug nas phrol// pho lha phrag pa g.yas nas phrol// yul lha phrag pa g.yon nas phrol// srog lha snying gi dkyil nas phrol// zhang lha lte ba'i dbus nas phrol// ma lha gsang ba'i gnas nas phrol// ban bon la sogs 'go ba'i lha// rig 'dzin srung ma rgyab nas phrol// bang lha mdzod khang nang nas phrol// a nṛ traka rak+sha mā ra ya phyes/ ma ma traka ru tra mā ra ya phyes/ 'di yan lha dbye'i sngags/ 'jam dpal sku mdog dmar nag g.yas ral gri dang g.yon rdo rje'i zhags pa 'phen pa sku la dur khrod kyi chas brgyad kyis brgyan pa/ zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum pad zla'i gdan la bzhengs pa/

rab tu khros shing cher 'bar ba/ zhal phyir gzigs nas zlog pa'am/ bsad pa'am/ mnan pa'i las mdzad par gyur/ lha tshogs thams cad zhal phyir gyu nas bzlog pa'am/ bsad pa'am/ mnan pa'i las mdzad par gyur/ zlog bsad la/ rang gi mdun du'ang khro bo shin tu 'jigs pa sku dang yan lag rags pa phyag na spu gri dang lcags kyu thogs pa gcig yod pa'i thugs ka nas/ lcags kyu dang*/ zhags pa/ lcags sgrog /dril bu thogs pa dpag tu med pa spros pas/ byad ma bkug nas rang gshed phab par bsam zhes zhal gdams su gsungs 'dug /rang 'di zlog pa'i dmigs pa yin/ gi thugs ka dang ba spu'i bu ga rnams nas/ khro bo khro mo mtshon cha sna tshogs bsnams pa skar ltar 'khrugs shing glog ltar 'khyug pa rnams kyis byad ma lha srung dang bcas pa rnams phar bzlog cing thal ba bun bun btang zhing*/ mes bsregs/ rlung gis gtor/ chus bshal/ sas mnan pa'i las byas/ lhag ma stobs can tshur byung ba rnams kyang mtshon cha'i 'khor los gtub cing tshur nye ma nus par byad ma'i steng du bab nas rang gshed rang la dbab pa'i las byed par gyur/ byad ma'i khog par gnam lcags kyi 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi pa mu khyud med pa zhig gis brgyangs shing g.yo 'gul med par gyur/ lha tshogs thams cad zhal phyir gzigs nas zlog sngags 'brug ldir ba ltar gsung bzhin pas bzlog pa'i las mdzad par bsam nas bzla'o// zhes zhal gdams las 'byung*/ oṃ e ka ya ma du ru tsakras zlog /he ka ya ma du ru tsakras zlog /gh+ri ma ya ma du ru tsakras zlog /sarba tsit+ta gzir thuṃ/ bhig nan trig nan rbad ya zlog ya/ dgra bo byad ma lha srung dang bcas pa'i sha la rgyugs/ snying la mā ra ya rgyugs/ dbugs la rgyugs/ srog la mā ra ya rgyugs/ khrag la rgyugs| rtsa la mā ra ya rgyugs hūm̐ phaṭa/ dgra bo byad ma lha srung dang bcas pa mā ra ya zlog ya/ zhes bzla zhing smyug tshigs yod na thal mo'i bar du sgril cing du na bdun pa bzla ba dang*/

mchan/ thal mo brdabs/ de ltar bzlas pa la 'bad pas bzlog pa'i rtags gzhung bzhin 'byung*/ rtags ni dmag chen bzlog pa dang*/ ser ba bzlog pa/ chu bsgyur ba/ brag bshig pa/ rdzing brdol ba/ rdo rlog pa sogs rig pas dpyad do// zhes lag len dngos gzhi'i gzhung las so| |bsad pa dang nyen zlog gi dmigs pa ni/ yang*/ rang gshin rje'i gshed du gsal ba'i phyag g.yon dang po'i lcags kyus kho'i snying ga'i nṛ nas bzung ste liṅga la bstims/ g.yas 'khor los gtubs nas sha khrag gtor zhing kho 'go ba'i lha dang bral ba nyam thag pa/ de la kho rang gi lha srung sprul pa dang bcas pa de rnams kyang log lta skyes te/ mtshon cha'i char 'bebs shing rang gshed rang la dbab pa'i las byas/ byad ma'i khog par gnam lcags kyi 'khor lo rtsibs bzhi pa mu khyud la ma reg pa gnyis g.yas g.yon du 'khor nas srog rtsa/ khrag rtsa/ snying rtsa thams cad rbad rbad gcod cing las kyi gshin rje'i dmag tshogs rnams kyis kyang gsod gcod kyi las byed par gyur/ oṃ e ka ya ma du ru tsakras sod/ he ka ya ma du ru tsakras sod/ gh+ri ma ya ma du ru tsakras sod| sarba tsit+ta gzir thuṃ/ bhig nan trig nan/ rbad ya sod ya/ dgra bo byad ma lha srung dang bcas pa'i sha la rgyugs/ snying la mā ra ya rgyugs/ dbugs la rgyugs/ srog la mā ra ya rgyugs| khrag la rgyugs/ rtsa la mā ra ya rgyugs hūm̐ phaṭa/ dgra bo byad ma lha srung dang bcas pa mā ra ya sod ya/ nṛ mā ra ya rbad ya/ oṃ rā tri'i srog la mā ra ya rbad ya/ klu bdud nag po dgra bo'i srog la mā ra ya rbad sod/ ces sngags kyis bsad par bsam zhes zhal gdams las so// mchan// brgya rtsa brgyad/ bsad pa'i rtags ni sems can kyi rigs mang po bsad pa dang*/ snying ster ba dang*/ shing bcad pa dang*/ ri bsnyil ba sogs rtags ma byung bar du bya'o// zhes pa lag len dngos gzhi'i gzhung du gsungs 'dug go// skabs 'dir mnan pa'i sa mā dhi dang sngags ni gza' gdong dmar nag zhal gdams su gsal bar bris yod pa ltar bya'o| |slar yang zlog bsad gnyis dril la drag tu byas shing*/

thun mong tshe bdag e ka= oṃ e ka ya ma du ru tsakras sod/ spyi mthun tshe bdag he ka= he ka ya ma du ru tsakras sod/ spyi dril tshe bdag gh+ri ma= gh+ri ma ya ma du ru tsakras sod/ dgra bo sarba sarba tsit+ta gzir thum bhig nan trig nan rbad ya zlog ya/ byad ma'i dam nyams byad ma lha dang bcas pa'i srog snying la mā ra ya rbad sod/ snying la mā ra ya sod ya/ srung ma yul lha phar zlog de bka'i lha srung ma dang bcas pa mā ra ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ dus de'i bka' srung lha dang bcas pa mā ra ya sod ya/ du na bdun pa 'di man chad ltar 'don dgos rgyu yin no// yaṃ yaṃ/ bh+yo bh+yo/ dgra la bh+yo/ e ka gshin rje/ du na dgra bo'i gshed du mā ra ya rbad/ sa ga sa bdag /du na sha trūṃ dgra bo'i gshed du mā ra ya rbad/ tsa tur btsan/ snying la sha trūṃ dgra bo'i gshed du mā ra ya rbad/ rā tsa rgyal po/ du na sa du dgra bo'i gshed du mā ra ya rbad/ bdud ta kor du na sa du dgra bo'i gshed du mā ra ya rbad/ ma hā lha chen/ du na sa du dgra bo'i gshed du mā ra ya rbad/ nā ga klu/ du na sa du dgra bo'i gshed du mā ra ya rbad/ ma ma mo/ mo du na sa du dgra bo'i gshed du mā ra ya rbad/ sha trūṃ mā ra ya dgra bo'i gshed du rbad/ a lha/ ya gshin rje/ ma ma mo/ du bdud/ ru srin po/ tsa btsan/ sha gza'/ na klu/ sa ma ya tsit+ta dkrugs dgra bo'i gshed du mā ra ya/ mthu byed bsam sbyor ngan pa thams cad kyi gshed du mā ra ya rbad/ bh+yo bh+yo/ zlog zlog /bsgyur bsgyur/ nan nan du na bdun po mi 'dra ba mang po yod kyang blos bkal chog pa'i dag po yod pa 'di yin/ ngag 'don la lar du na bdun pa dag po yong gi med pas blos ma 'gel zhig /mchan/ 'di ban dgra drag po dang 'gras na ma gtogs sngags 'di blo la 'jug tu mi btub/

bzlas pa'i rjes thal mo brdab/ dmigs pa bya/ dmod pa bya/ thun gtor dgug gzhug lha sngags dmigs tsam gyis lha dbye byas la sngags lan gsum kyi rjes su/ oṃ rā tri'i srog la mā ra ya rbad/ klu bdud nag po dgra bo'i srog la mā ra ya i daṃ ba ling+ta kha kha khā hi khā hi| dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag rus gsum la kha kha khā hi khā hi/ las kyi gshin rje yab yum 'khor bcas kyis dgra bgegs kyi sha khrag thams cad hab di ri ri gsol zhing phrin las gang bcol thogs pa med par sgrub par bsam mo// drag po'i bskul thung ni/ hūm̐/ gru gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i klong dkyil na// gshin rje ma he nyi zla pad+ma'i gdan steng du// yab gcig lha yi rgyal po khro rgyal gshin rje'i gshed// sbyor ba'i yum mchog ma mo khrag mig ma// sgrol ba'i yum mchog e ka gcig /tsa ti ral pa/ sgra gsar pa rnams su dzā ti zer/ ral gcig ma// thugs kyi sprul pa mched bzhi yod pa las 'di ging rme ru rtse yin/ sgrol ging me ru rtse// dus gsum sprul pa gsum/ gshin rje bzhi gshed bzhi/ bdud bzhi/ mon pa bzhi/ dang phyogs skyong bcu// sgrol ging bdud bco brgyad/ 'chi bdag bcu gcig /gshin rje so gnyis/ ma mo phung byed sbas pa'i mkha' 'gro rdo rje rigs kyi gyad gnon khyung seng stag sbrul gyi lha brgyad sogs// de la sogs pa 'jam dpal sku yi rigs rgyud thugs ye shes pa rnams sngon sems can gyi don mdzad par thugs bskyed pa dang*/ dregs pa rnams ni ye shes pa'i spyan sngar khas blangs pa'i dam can// mi mngon chos kyi dbyings nas sku bzhengs bdag la byin gyis rlobs| |thugs dam brgyud bskul thugs rjes dgra bgegs sgrol/ bstod ring ni/ e/ chos kyi dbyings sangs rgyas thams cad kyi khams rgyud la bzhugs pa'i phyir/

kyi pho brang dam pa na// gshin rje ma he nyi zla pad+ma'i steng*// bcom ldan 'das 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed thabs bde ba chen po'i rang bzhin po ni// mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bsgrad// g.yas zhal sprul pa'i sku dkar la bzhad pas klu 'bum gsol/ /g.yon zhal longs spyod rdzogs pa'i sku dmar la dwangs pas gnyan khri gsol// dbus zhal chos kyi sku mthing la rngam pas sa bdag gsol// phyag g.yas dang pos chos nyid don dam pa'i 'khor lo rtsibs brgyad pas dgra bgegs kyi tshogs brgyad gtub// bar pas ye shes kyi ral gris dgra bgegs bdud bzhi'i srog rtsa gcod// tha ma don dam pa'i rdo rjes 'jigs tshogs la lta ba'i dgra bgegs rdul du rlog /phyag g.yon dang pos 'khor ba mi gtong bar thugs rje'i lcags kyus dgra bgegs rigs drug ngan song las thar bar 'gugs// bar pas ye shes kyi gtun shing gis nyon mongs pa dgra bgegs rnams la rdeg /tha mas sdigs mdzub dgra bgegs rnams la gzir// zhabs bzhi tshad med bzhi dang bsdu dngos gzhi'i g.yas brkyang g.yon bskum dgra bgegs brdzis| |thod skam rigs lnga'i pho brang dang ra ri dang thod rlon 'du byed lnga bcu dag pa'i phreng ba yis// dbu rgyan rgyal bas dbang bskur ba mgul rgyan do shal mdzes par brgyan// glang chen gti mug dag pa/ zhing 'dod chags dag pa/ dang stag lpags zhe sdang dag pa/ sku la gsol// klu rgyal rigs dang rje rigs dang bram ze dang dmangs rigs dang*// gdol ba'i rigs mtshon sbrul lngas dbu zhabs brgyan pa dug lnga gnas su dag pa// rak+ta'i zhag gi zo ris thal chen gsum gyis spras/ sku gsum gyi don dang ldan pa/ bskal pa'i me dpung dbus na 'gying bar bzhugs| |gzugs dag pa spyan bgrad shangs gnyer ro dag pa zhal gdangs ljags 'dril zhing*// bdud bzhi 'joms pa'i mche ba rab gtsigs dgra ngar 'dzin/

yi don snying za// spyi gtsug khyung nag me yi gshog pa can// rwa dang mchu sder gnam lcags 'bar ba yis// klu gnyan sa bdag ma lus gsod cing gnon// gtso bo'i ba spu khyung dang rdo rje'i rab tu gtams// lha srin sde brgyad pho nya dgra la 'gyed// dmigs pa gang yin de nyid da lta brlag /khro rgyal gshin rje'i gshed kyi thugs dam dus la bab// 'khor gyi gshin rje bye ba sa ya dgra la bh+yo// ba liṃ sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la// byad ma lha srung rang gshed rang la phob// hūm̐ */ khro rgyal chen po'i g.yon gyi phyogs na ni// shes rab stong pa nyid kyi rang bzhin gsod byed yum chen ma mo khrag mig ma// sku mdog dmar mo 'dod chags dag pa/ zhal gcig don dam bden pa/ phyag gnyis ma/ thabs shes// gcer bu 'khor ba'i skyon gyis ma gos pa skyon thams cad dag pa/ rgyan med gzig sham spyan bgrad chos nyid don dam pa'i khro gnyer can// zhal gdang ljags 'dril 'khor ba las sgrol ba'i mche gtsigs 'jig tshogs log lta gcod pa'i rkan sgra rdeb/ dug gsum sgrol ba rngam pa/ phyag g.yas 'dod chags dag kyang der snang 'dod pa'i lcags kyus dgra bgegs dbang med par bde ba chen po'i sar 'gugs// phyag g.yon nyams pa'i thod khrag snying rje'i 'khor ba'i rang bzhin zhal du rol bas rgyun gcod// zhabs thabs shes gnyis dor stabs rab bgrad dgra bgegs rtag chad mnan// yum mchog e ka tsa ti'i thugs dam dus la bab// 'khor gyi ma mo'i dmag tshogs dgra la bh+yo// ba liṃ sha khrag gtor ma 'di zhes la// byad ma lha srung rang gshed rang la phob/ /hūm̐ */ g.yas na thabs shes gnyis su med pa'i sras mchog ya ma rā tsa ni// sku mdog chos nyid mi 'gyur ba'i smug nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa bden pa gnyis// rab 'jigs nyon mongs gcod pa gcer bu zhabs thabs shes gnyis brkyang bskum mnyam rol bzhugs// mi lpags g.yang gzhi'i stag lpags zhe sdang dag pa sku la gsol// phyag g.yas nges pa don gyi bshan gris dgra bgegs kun rdzob 'khrul pa ma lus gtub// phyag g.yon dgra bgegs rnams kyi don snying sems can la rjes su chags pas 'drad// gsod byed ya ma rā tsa'i thugs dam dus la bab/ */'khor gyi las mkhan sde brgyad dgra la bh+yo// ba liṃ sha khrag gtor ma 'di zhes la// byad ma lha srung rang gshed rang la phob// gzhan yang khro rgyal khyed rnams 'khor bcas la// phrin las bcol ba 'di rnams da mdzod /rdo rje slob dpon gyi sku gsung thugs la smod pa da1nga*// yi dam gyi lha smod cing brnyas par byed pa 2dang*// dkon mchog gsum 3la smod cing chos skyong smod4/ pa dang*// rdo rje theg pa'i rim gnyis bsnyen sgrub zab mo'i bar gcod byed pa da5nga*// rdo rje'i mched grogs la 'a6khu zhing dam tshig las ldog pa da7nga*// gzhan dam tshig can la gnod pa byed pa8 yi// bla ma dang bstan pa la sdang ba'i dgra da9nga gnod pa byed pa'i bgeg10sa/ drag po mngon spyod kyis bsgral bar 'os pa'i zhing bcu ni 'di bcu yin gyi 'ga' zhig gis ngan song gsum sogs zhing bcur 'dren pa ni ha cang thal ches so// rings par khug la srog dang da phrol cig /dbang du bsdus la thal ba'i rdul du rlog /bcol pa'i phrin las myur du grub par mdzod// drag por bskul ba ni/ e/ chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang na// drag po e bha ga gru gsum/ yi gzhal yas na// klu sbrul nag gyi rnam pa 'bum gnyan khri lcong mo'i rnam par sa bdag sbal nag gi rnam par zhes lcags sdig nag po stong gi gdan// lto 'phye chen po dang phyogs skyong bcu'am bco lnga nyi zla brtsegs pa'i steng*// bcom ldan zil gnon tshe bdag nag po'i sku// mthing nag zhal gsum phyag drug zhabs bzhi bsgrad// g.yas zhal dkar la bzhad pas dgod dgod 'dra// g.yon zhal dmar la dwangs pas chags chags 'dra// dbus zhal mthing la rngam pas khro khro 'dra// sku che yan lag rags pas 'jigs 'jigs 'dra// rgyan dang cha lugs dur khrod dpal gyi chas brgyad sogs ldan pas chas chas 'dra// mtshan so gnyis dang dpe byad brgyad cu ldan pas brjid brjid 'dra// bdud lha nyon 'chi phung bzhi thal bar rlog pas dpa' dpa' 'dra| |bskal pa'i me dpung gi nang na bzhugs pas 'bar 'bar 'dra// rgyud drug 'gro ba rigs drug thugs rjes 'dren pas brtse brtse 'dra// de 'dra'i thugs rjes khro chen 'bar ba'i sku bzhengs 'tshal| |'og min chos kyi dbyings kyi pho brang nas// glog ltar myur ba'i thugs rjes 'dir byon la// bdag nyid rig 'dzin sgrub pa po la byin phob cig

/lus la mtshan dpes brgyan pa thob pa'i rdo rje'i sku yi byin phob cig /ngag la bden tshig dbyangs yan lag drug cu dang ldan pa'i gsung gi byin phob cig /yid la rang byung thugs bde stong zab gsal gnyis med kyi ye shes kyi byin phob cig /skye 'gro thams cad kyis yon tan 'gran du med pa phas rgol zil gyis gnon pa'i byin phob cig /phrin las 'gro ba rnams 'dul phyir zhi rgyas dbang drag rnam bzhi'i byin phob cig /dbang chen khyod kyis bdag la dbang bskur zil gnon bcom ldan 'das// byin chen khyod kyis bdag la byin phob zil gnon bcom ldan 'das// mthu chen khyod kyis bdag la mthu rtsal nas stobs thams cad zil gnon bcom ldan 'das// dngos grub phyag rgya chen po mchog bdag la stsol zhig zil gnon bcom ldan 'das// bdag nyid gang 'dod pa'i las kyi 'bras bu da lta mchis par mdzod// bdag gis lus ngag yid gsum rtse gcig gus pas lha khyod bsgrub na// khyod kyi thugs rjes bdag la byin gyis rlobs/ shig /dus ngan snyigs ma'i lnga bdo ba'i dus su bdag skyes pas// bdag ni bla med byang chub bsgrub pa la/ /sa dang lam la gegs med du bgrod par bar du gcod pa'i dgra bgegs dang*// bdud bzhi dang lha 'dre phas rgol ngan sems can rnams kyis/ /bdag gi tshe srog dang thar pa thob pa'i sa lam la bar du gcod pa rnams// dpal chen zil gnon 'khor dang bcas pa yis// kho rang bdag gis dbang med par dbang du bsdus nas kyang zhi bas 'dul/ gal te zhi bas ma thul na thugs rjes gtum zhing rngam pa'i shugs kyis bsgral nas ni// gru sha khrag rus pa gsum mthing nag 'bar ba'i rnam shes sprul sku thob bar byas/

zhal du bstab// gsung dbyangs drug cu ldan pa'i mgul du longs sku thob par byas/ bsgril// rnam dag skye med thugs kyi dkyil du bstims chos sku thob par byas// sgrub mchog bdag gi bsam don gyi gtso bo byang chub thob pa'i sa lam| |bar chad med par dus 'dir grub par mdzod cig /de nas thun gtor dbul/ mthar rang gi thugs ka nas 'od zer 'phros srung 'khor rnams rim gyis mtha' nas bsdu/ bsrung bya rnams la phog /de rnams kyang hūm̐ la bsdu/ hūm̐ thig le la bsdu/ de yang rang gi ming yig dang po la thim par gyur/ nyer bsdu la rjes gzhig dang ril 'dzin gnyis las 'dir ni ril 'dzin gyis bsdu rim yin no// bsrung bya rnams la phog /de rnams kyang hūm̐ la bsdu/ hūm̐ ni thig le la bsdu/ de yang rang gi ming yig dang po la thim par gyur/ ces pa'i ngang nas sems dus gsum gyi spros ba'i mtha' dang bral zhing gang shar gzo med du ci gnas su mnyam par bzhag de las ldang ba'i tshe dpa' bo gcig pa'i tshul gyis ldang bar yin no// slar yang rang nyid 'jam dpal gshin rje'i gshed zhal gcig phyag g.yas 'khor lo dang g.yon lcags kyu 'dzin pa zhabs gnyis pa rus rgyan phyag rgya drug gi skabs dang 'dra/ gnyis pa'i skur gsal bar gyur pa'i ngang nas spyod lam la 'jug go// thun mtshams chos thams cad 'od gsal stong pa nyid du yang dag par bltas nas/ gzhi lam 'bras bu'i 'od gsal phyag rgya chen po la yun ring du goms par bya ba ni 'od gsal kyi ngang du 'jug pa dang*/ de las phyag gnyis pa'i sku sgyu ma lta bu med bzhin du snang ba'i skur ldang ba ste/ des na pha rgyud kyi nyams len gyi snying po chos thams cad 'od gsal du 'jug pa dang de las lha sku sgyu ma lta bu ldang zhing brtan g.yo thams cad sgyu ma sbyang ba'i gnad 'di shes na pha rgyud kyi bskyed rdzogs kyi gnad thams cad 'di la ma 'dus pa med pas skal pa dang ldan pa rnams kyis mkhyen par mdzod cig

༈ yang zlog me'i spu gri las srung zlog gi las gal che na/ yang gab sbas pa'i lha gnyis bskyed pa ni/ sras kyi rjes su/ mdun du sku'i sprul 'chi bdag nag po bdud bye ba dgu khri yang zer/ sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig /phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas ri rab 'phyar zhing g.yon dgra sta gdengs pa/ sku stod la gnam lcags kyi zhun khrab gsol ba/ sku sked la zhing lpags kyi mgo bo g.yas su bstan te ska rags bcings pa/ sku smad la stag lpags kyi sham thabs mgo bo g.yas su grol ba gsol ba/ thod pa skam po lngas dbu la brgyan pa/ zhing chung gi chos gos byas pa/ sbrul gyi yan lag dkris pa/ zhabs gnyis dor stabs su bgrad nas chu glang sngon po la bcibs pa/ 'khor du sku'i sprul pa bye ba sa yas bskor ba/ rgyab tu gsung gi sprul pa srog bdag nag po sgrol ging me ru rtse yang zer/ sku mdog dmar nag zhal gcig /phyag gnyis pa/ thod pa'i rna cha can/ sbrul nag gi ral pa spyi bor bcings shing*/ g.yas pas be con dang g.yon pas zhags pa bsnams pa/ sku la rus sbal nag po'i g.yang gzhi gsol ba/ mgo bo g.yas su phyogs pa/ zhabs gnyis dor stabs su bgrad nas las kyi rlung dmar kyi rta la bcibs pa/ 'khor du gsung gi sprul pa bye ba sa yas bskor ba/ de gnyis kyi thugs kar ya dmar nag gi mthar/ sarba tsit+ta gzir thuṃ bhig nan trig nan rbad ya zlog ya/ zhes pas bskor bar gyur ces dang*/ spyan 'dren gyi skabs su/ sku sprul 'chi bdag nag po gshegs su gsol| |gsung sprul srog bdag nag po gshegs su gsol// 'khor gyi gshin rje'i dmag tshogs gshegs su gsol// zhes dang*/ phyag 'tshal ba'i skabs su/ 'chi bdag nag po'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// srog bdag nag po'i sku la phyag 'tshal bstod// 'khor gyi gshin rje'i tshogs la phyag 'tshal bstod// ces gdag /bstod bskul gyi skabs su/

mdun na sku sprul 'chi bdag nag po ni// sku mdog mthing nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa// g.yas pas ri rab g.yon pas dgra sta bsnams// gnam lcags zhun khrab zhing lpags stag sham gsol// thod skam dbu brgyan zhing chung chos gos can// sbrul gyis brgyan cing chu glang sngon po bcibs// sku sprul 'chi bdag nag po'i thugs dam dus la bab// 'chi bdag bye ba sa ya dgra la bh+yo// ba liṃ sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la// byad ma lha srung rang gshed rang la phob// ces dang*// rgyab na gsung sprul srog bdag nag po ni// sku mdog dmar nag zhal gcig phyag gnyis pa// thod pa'i rna cha sbrul nag ral pa bcings// g.yas pas be con g.yon pas zhags pa bsnams// sku la rus sbal nag po'i g.yang gzhi gsol// zhabs gnyis dor stabs las kyi rlung dmar bcibs| |gsung sprul srog bdag nag po'i thugs dam dus la bab// srog bdag bye ba sa ya dgra la bh+yo// ba liṃ sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la// byad ma lha srung rang gshed rang la phob| |ces sogs sbyor/ bsrung ba'i dus su sham bu rnams su/ ba liṃ sha khrag gtor ma 'di bzhes la// rnal 'byor bdag cag dpon slob mi nor 'khor// srung zhing skyob pa'i phrin las sgrub pa dang*// nad gdon bar chad zhi ba'i las mdzod cig /tshe dpal 'byor chogs rgyas pa'i las mdzod cig /mos bzhis khams gsum srid gsum dbang du bsdus// bstan gnod phyi nang dgra bgegs thal bar rlog /ces dang*/ zlog pa'i sham bu ni/ chag chen nyam nga bzlog pa'i las mdzod cig /byad kha phur kha bzlog pa'i las mdzod cig /rmi ltas mtshan ngan bzlog pa'i las mdzod cig /lo skag zla skag bzlog pa'i las mdzod cig /zhag skag za skag bzlog pa'i las mdzod cig /dus min 'chi ba bzlog pa'i las mdzod cig /byad ma lha srung rang gshed rang la phob// rang nyid gshin rje'i gshed kyi thugs kar phyag na rdo rje/

de'i thugs kar 'jam dpal phyag na rdo rje/ de'i thugs kar gser gyi rdo rje rtse dgu pa/ de'i lte ba'i nang du nyi zla'i ga'u kha sbyor/ de'i nang du rang gi rnam par shes pa'i ngo bo yi ge hūm̐ mthing nag 'a 'dogs kyi nang du bsrung bya thams cad gnas par gyur/ g.yas skor yin no// rang nyid yi dam du gsal bas/ kho rang gi lha srung thams cad kyis kho rang gi gshed du phar 'khor bar bsams la/ sngags zlog bzlas/ bcas yod na/ thun yang bcas yod na zlog bsad mnan pa'i thun gtor yang las gshin thun phur dang 'dra ba las khyad par ni phyag g.yon sdigs mdzub kyis zhags pa 'dzin pa ma gtogs thun thag la mi 'dzin par bskyed do/ phur las kyi gshin rje sku mdog dmar nag zhal gcig /phyag gnyis pa/ g.yas be con brdeg pa'i tshul du 'phyar ba/ g.yon pas dgra bgegs kyi don snying 'drad pa'i tshul du sdigs mdzub kyis thun thag 'dzin pa/ stag gi pags pa'i sham thabs can/ zhabs gnyis brkyang bskum du bzhugs par gyur/ da ni las de dag thams cad bar gcod med par 'grub pa'i rgyu'i gtso bo bdag gzhan gnyis med du bsad de gol sa bzlog pa ni/ gtor ma sogs las rab 'byams gang sgrub pa'i tshe na'ang*/ bdag dang lha dang dgra bgegs la sogs pa so sor bzung zhing*/ zhe sdang phrag dog drag po kho nas kun nas bslangs pa'i ban sngags nag po rang rgyud ngan par ma btang bar/ las sgrub pa'i tshe phyi'i gdon bgegs kyang rang gi sems/ nang gi rnam rtog kyang rang gi sems/ gsang ba rtsa rlung dug lnga dug gsum sogs kyang rang gi sems/ snod bcud 'khor 'das thams cad rang sems stong pa chos sku 'od gsal klong 'byams kun tu bzang po'i rol pa las gang du'ang ma 'das pas/ bdag gzhan gnyis snang gzung 'dzin gyi chos dang chos can thams cad ngo bos ma grub cing*/ med pa stong pa chos sku thig le nyag gcig tu rtogs pa'i lta bas thag bcad cing rgyas btab/

de tsa na gnyis med rtogs pa'i gol sa chod pa yin no// de ltar las de'i rang mdangs rang rtsal ma 'gag par shar ba'i lha dang*/ sgrub pa po dang*/ dgra dang*/ gdon la sogs pa thams cad kyang med bzhin du snang ba sgyu ma'i skyes bu'i mkhar zhing*/ rta glang*/ dmag la sogs pa snang ba dang khyad rdul tsam yang med pas/ med bzhin snang ba'i yul la/ med bzhin snang ba'i las byas pas/ med bzhin snang ba'i 'bras bu 'byung ba ni chos nyid yin pas/ don 'di rnams/ rab bcos min gyi myong rtogs nang nas shar ba/ 'bring bcos ma'i nyams myong brtan po dang ldan pa/ tha mas kyang de ltar yin pa'i go yul dang dran 'dzin snying rus zhe phur btab nas/ yang yang gsal 'debs pa ni las thams cad 'grub pa'i rgyu'i gtso bo yin pas yid la nges pa gal che'o// de skad du dharma kīrtis smras so// //sarba maṅga laṃ//
